context: Reference focused cleanup: gather lookup IDs across a batch before rendering so helpers do not hide repeated network I/O.

checklist.name: Creates coherent Java 17 snippets
checklist.description: Returns coherent Java 17-compatible revised snippets that preserve the represented class, records, helper methods, and public method shape.

checklist.name: Analyzes cards before lookup
checklist.description: Creates an analysis or equivalent phase so each card's plan and prompt reference texts are known before card-state lookup happens.

checklist.name: Batches lookup IDs once
checklist.description: Collects all prerequisite and prompt-reference lookup IDs across the full card batch, applies distinct at the batch boundary, and calls fetchCardStatesByIds once.

checklist.name: Keeps rendering pure
checklist.description: Makes prompt rendering use already available lookup results and avoids helper methods named like renderers that perform hidden network I/O.

checklist.name: Keeps writes explicit
checklist.description: Keeps checklist synchronization or other externally visible writes outside stream pipelines and visible in an explicit per-card step.

checklist.name: Preserves reference behavior
checklist.description: Does not drop prompt references, plan references, card order, rendered-reference creation, or checklist sync behavior while separating phases.

checklist.name: Avoids stream-heavy overreach
checklist.description: Does not hide Trello or network side effects in map, peek, collectors, or broad custom frameworks.

metadata.reference_selection: Focused issue #41 coverage for batch lookup before rendering.
metadata.runtime_reference_overlap_rationale: Allowed only as reference-suite focused coverage; do not report as ordinary broad lift if runtime references later teach this same phase-separation shape.
